notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
[b][Minor Update][/b]

Dear Players,
Here's a minor update for the playtest, which mainly focus on UI elements. These changes should enhance the game experience for those playing with different resolution!

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
- Fixed Tutorials UI Overlapping
- Fixed Resolution Dropdown in Options Menu not setting resolution
- Fixed Mouse Cursor to become invisible when interacting with TVs/Regulators
- Fixed Main Menu Overlapping UI
- Fixed game being on pause upon Retry/New game/Load game

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]
- Changed Tutorial Panels Transparency
- Changed Interacting Tooltip to display Key button

[u][b]Additions[/b][/u]
- Added Support for 4k Resolution
- Added "Continue" Button in Pause Menu
- Added "Skip" feature button during Introduction Video

Best Regards,
Horrora Studio

notes.title: 1 Year Later
notes.notes:
Dear gamers!

First of all, thanks to everyone who has been patient enough to test the first 'playable' build!
It was my first step toward releasing anything about the game.
Its been about a year since I published it. Of course, it was full of bugs and felt unfinished.
But anyway, It is such an amazing feeling to be able to share with gamers of all around the world.

I have been working on it from time to time, and managed to build a more stable gameplay overall.
I believe the game still needs a lot of work though, but it's always fun to share with you guys the new stuffs i've been added/tweaked/changed since then!

Things are getting serious here, and also more on the storyline to discover.
The playtest shall remain open along with a new update to come!
Let's call it the alpha 2 for now. The second playtest shall remain open for an unknown limited time though. More about that later.

Stay tuned for the next update of the great cosmic horror,
Cheers!

notes.title: Alpha Testing
notes.notes:
Dear gamers!

Thank you in advance for joining in the Playtest for The Night Walkers! 

This have been a long road so far, and everything is still under development. Please note that a lot of bugs can happen while you test the game. Hope you enjoy the experience of this first testable build!

Cheers!
